did: The planner split the 38 criteria into four stories that take turns.
decided: Each story keeps its criteria word for word from the issue.
Each story's own planner writes its tests and edge cases.

handback.summary: The split keeps all 38 criteria word for word, in four stories of ten or fewer.

asks.ask: Dokima ships one defaults file that every repo's settings fall back to.
A repo's settings file changes only the settings it names; every other keeps its default.
The defaults file holds every setting of the owner's 41-row list, each with the default the list names.
A settings file holding lists is read in full, on every machine that runs Dokima.
Saving a setting through setup keeps the file's comments.
Saving a setting through setup keeps comments written at the end of a line.
Saving one setting through setup leaves every other setting as it was.
The agents section of the settings file picks each role's agent and model.
A repo with only the old agents file still runs each role's agent as named there.
A settings group in a repo's file merges with the defaults key by key, the repo winning.
A list in a repo's file replaces the default list whole.
Gates in a repo's file merge with the default gates by name.
Prompt additions in a repo's file merge with the default ones by name.
An unknown setting shows a warning that suggests the closest known name.
An unknown setting is ignored and the run goes on.
Setting any of the five locked settings in a repo's file fails the run, naming it.
No setting in a repo's file changes the order: plan, review, build, review, merge.
The repo's own install command runs before its tests in every test workflow.
The test tools each test workflow installs come from the test tools setting.
The repo's tests run on the Python version the settings name.
The all tests check runs the all-tests command from settings.
Each criterion's check runs the per-criterion command from settings.
Setting affected tests to all runs every test before review, with no saved baseline.
Handling a clash with main keeps the test folder named in settings.
The planner's push holds only files in the test folder named in settings.
Tests on the merge gate exclude list stay out of the all tests check.
Agents base their branches and pull requests on the default branch setting.
Each run's conversation is saved on the records branch the settings name.
Only the bot named in settings may send the next-step signal.
Commits Dokima makes carry the git identity of the bot named in settings.
The co-author line on Dokima's commits comes from the co-author setting.
Agents copy the owner docs file the settings name, in place of the rules file.
The planner and worker prompts name the owner docs file the settings name.
The worker's prompt lists the protected paths the settings name.
The planner prompt's runner line is drawn from the test settings.
The style prompt's caps table is drawn from the caps setting.
A repo's house rules file is added after the shipped prompt.
A house rules section named for a role is added only to that role's prompt.
